solution_comment: Reset the drive and verify non-volatile memory wear levels are within specifications.
Verify memory wear levels, then reset the drive.
Replace the non-volatile memory module if wear exceeds 90 %.
Inspect motor cooling fan and ensure unobstructed ventilation.
Remove dust buildup from heat-sink fins to reduce motor temperature.
Reduce load or speed until motor temperature returns to safe range.
Restart the intelligent power module after checking for short circuits.
Replace faulty gate-driver board causing IPM fault condition.
Verify phase current sensors to rule out over-current false positives.
Reset the drive and verify DC-bus voltage meets minimum threshold.
Check upstream rectifier for blown fuses causing undervoltage.
Stabilise mains supply; add power-conditioning if fluctuations persist.
Verify braking resistor operation to dissipate regenerative energy.
Measure incoming AC voltage; adjust tap settings to reduce bus overvoltage.
Inspect DC-link capacitors for degradation causing voltage spikes.
Home sensor misaligned – adjust and rerun home search routine.
Remove mechanical obstructions preventing axis from reaching home position.
Update motion controller firmware to improve homing reliability.
Reseat SERCOS connectors and reboot network nodes.
Replace damaged fibre-optic cable segment on DeviceNet ring.
Sync network baud rate between drive and master controller.
Update drive firmware to correct overspeed detection logic.
Verify encoder resolution and scaling factors.
Calibrate speed feedback loop to prevent false overspeed trips.
Clear obstruction on conveyor to resolve excess position error.
Tighten timing belt to maintain position accuracy.
Realign linear guide rails and rerun calibration.
Allow motor to cool, then reset thermal protection.
Inspect motor temperature sensor for drift.
Improve cabinet ventilation to lower ambient temperature.
Verify IPM heatsink contact; reapply thermal compound if needed.
Replace failed cooling fan on IPM power stage.
Reduce duty cycle until thermal limiter no longer trips.
Check PID gains; excessive velocity error indicates tuning issue.
Lubricate linear bearings to reduce friction.
Replace worn timing belt causing velocity inconsistencies.
Execute homing sequence before enabling axis motion.
Confirm limit switch wiring for axis not homed fault.
Restore controller parameters lost after power cycle.
Replace damaged encoder cable harness to clear comm fault.
Verify encoder power supply voltage is within tolerance.
Check shield grounding to reduce electrical noise on encoder lines.
Inspect motor cable insulation for damage causing ground fault.
Dry moisture inside junction box to eliminate leakage path.
Install ground-fault monitor for early detection of insulation breakdown.
Clean control cabinet filters to improve airflow across power electronics.
Replace failed fan tray cooling the power circuitry.
Reduce ambient temperature to within specified operating range.
Check facility power supply; restore AC line to the drive.
Verify drive enable signal is present on control terminal.
